**Finding: Compliant** (§ 8.2 / § 8.3) — no redline proposed.

The renewal provisions meet the playbook's *preferred* position on every material term:

| Playbook term | Preferred | Contract |
|---|---|---|
| Renewal term | 12 months | Successive twelve-month periods ✓ |
| Customer opt-out | 30 days' notice | Thirty days' written notice ✓ |
| Vendor reminder | 60 days before renewal | Sixty days beforehand ✓ |
| Price uplift cap | Lesser of CPI and 3% | Lesser of CPI and three percent ✓ |

Two additional terms are net-positive for us and were not flagged: a missed Vendor reminder extends our opt-out deadline to thirty days after receipt, and no increase applies to prepaid periods. The ninety-day notice of a price increase is a Vendor obligation benefiting us, not a non-renewal notice window, so it does not implicate the walk-away threshold.
